content: Xoossi Muses Immida Gita Wolqqa
Museykka GODAAS, «Istti tana ammanontta ixxiko woykko tani yootizayssa siyontta ixxidi, ‹GODAY nees qonccibeenna› giikko ta waanoo?» gides.
GODAY iza, «Hessi ne kushen dizay aazee?» gi oychchides. Izikka, «Guufekko» gides.
GODAYKKA iza, «Ane iza gaden yegga» gides. Musey he guufeza gaden yeggiin shoosh gidides; histtiin Musey izappe woxxi kichchides.
Hessafe guye GODAY iza, «Ne kushe yeddada shooshshaa goyna oykka» gides. Musey yeddidi shooshshaa goyna oykkiin shooshshazi iza kushen simmidi guufe gidides.
GODAY, «Hayssi hanidayssi ne aawata Abrahaame, Yisaaqanne Yaaqoobe Xoossi nees qonccidayssa istti ammanana malassa» gides.
Qasseka GODAY iza, «Ne kushe ne shophpha giddo gelththa» giin Musey ba kushe ba shophpha giddo gelththides; izi ba kusheza shophphaafe kessiza wode kushezi qaaratidi shachcha mala booxxides.
GODAY iza, «Ne kushe ne shophpha giddo zaara gelththa» gides. Histtiin Musey ba kushe ba shophpha giddo zaari gelththi kessiza wode iza kushey simmidi hankko bollaa mala gidides.
Qasseka GODAY izas, «Istti nena ammanontta aggiko koyro malaataa ammanontta ixxiko, nam7anththoza ammanana.

Gido attiin istti Xoossi ooththiza ha nam7u malaatata ammanontta aggiko woykko neni yootizayssa siyontta ixxiko, Nayle shaafappe haath duuqqa ekkada biitta bolla gussa; neni shaafaappe ekkida haaththi biitta bolla suuth gidana» gides.
Gido attiin Musey GODAAS, «Abeet Godoo! Tani hayssafe kasekka, woykko neni ne ayllezas taas yootoosoppe haa simmiinkka tani lo7eththa haasayanaas dandayontta as gidikkinaa?» gides.
GODAY izas, «Asas doona medhdhiday oonee? As duude, woykko tulle ooththizay oonee? Xeelanne qooqe ooththizay oonee? Tana GODAA gidikkinaa?
Neni ha7i ba; ne haasayana mala ta nenara gidananne nena maaddana; neni yootanayssaka ta nena tamaarsana» gides.
Gido attiin Musey GODAA, «Abeet Godoo! Hayssa ooththanaas hara as kiittarkkii!» gides.

Hessafe guye GODAY Muse bolla keehi hanqettidi iza, «Lewe baggafe gidida ne isha Aarooney dees gidennee? Izi lo7o haasayana dandayzayssa tani erays; ha7i izi nenara gaagganaas yishe oge bollan dees; izi nena be7idi ufayettana.
Neni izas yoota; izi yootana qaalaakka ne iza erisa; tani inttena nam7atakka haasayan maaddananne intte ooththanayssa tamaarsana.
Izi asaas ne gishshas yootana; hessika izi nees ne doona mala gidiin ne izas haasayza Xoossa mala gidana guussa.
Malaatata izan ooththanaas neni hayssa guufeza ekka» gides.
Gibxe Muse Simo
Hessafe guye Musey ba bollo, Yootorekko simmi biidi, «Hanno gakkanaas asay paxa dizaakko beyanaas tani guye ta asaakko Gibxe boo?» gides. Yootoreykka Muse, «Ee ba; saron gakka» gides.
Musey Midiyaame biittan dishin GODAY iza, «Nena wodhanaas koyida asati wuri hayqqida gishshas guye Gibxe biitta simma ba» gides.
Musey ba machchiyonne ba attuma nayta hare togisi ekkidi guye Gibxe simmishe Xoossa guufe oykki bides.

GODAY Muse, «Neni Gibxe simmada biza wode tani nees immida wolqqan neni ooththana malaatata ubbaa Gibxe kawo Paaroone sinththan neni ooththanayssa baloppa. Histtiinkka izi asaa yeddontta mala tani iza wozina muumisana.
He wode tani GODAY gizayssa kawaas: Isra7eeley taas bayra naa;
Ta naazi taas goynnanaas ne yeddana mala tani nees yootadis shin neni iza yeddontta ixxadasa; hessa gishshas, ‹Tani nees bayra naaza wodhana› gides gaada yoota» gides.
Oge bolla imaththi shempizason GODAY Musera gaaggidi iza wodhanaas koyides.
Iza machchiya Xipooray qara shuch ekkada ba naaza qaxxaradus. Qaxxarada he shurteza Muse toho bochchada Muse, «Neni taas tumu suuththa mishira» gadus.
Hessa gishshas GODAY iza wodhontta aggides. He wode qaxxaraa gaason izas, «Neni taas suuththa mishira» gadus.
GODAY Aaroone, «Neni Musera gaagganaas bazzo ba» giin izi biidi Musera Xoossa zumaa bolla gaaggidi iza yeerides.
Hessafe guye Musey GODAY ba bolla kiittida qaala ubbaa qasseka ooththana mala bana azazida malaatata ubbaa Aaroones yootides.
Museynne Aarooney biidi Isra7eele cimata ubbaa issi bolla shiishshida.
Aarooney GODAY Muses yootida qaala ubbaa isttas yootidessinne malaatata he asaa sinththan ooththides.
Isttika ammanida. GODAY isttako yidayssanne istta waaye be7idayssa siyida mala biitta bolla gufanni goynnida.

footnotes.text: Suuththa mishira gizayssi Muse machcha Musey hayqqontta mala naaza qaxxarida suuththaan Muse bochchiin Musey hayqoppe attidayssa bessees.
